decision.rationale: The disputed charge TXN-007858 (22.72 EUR, Kestrel Athletic Club, card CRD-000076) was made on 2026-09-25 and posted on 2026-09-26. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, which is within the 120-day time limit. The merchant's cancellation confirmation DOC-000007 says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-27. That is two days after the charge. The charge therefore covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge, the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The Kestrel Athletic Club charge of 22.72 EUR was made on 2026-09-25. The merchant's confirmation shows your cancellation took effect on 2026-09-27, after this charge, so the charge was for a period the subscription was still active.
